# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: what a bomb plant and a bomb defuse do to a player.
# map mp_carentan, gametype sd (served as probe_lookat), joined allies, weapon m1carbine_mp, role attacker
# Three shells, the gsc probe first, then the defender, then the attacker:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> SECS=420 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_lookat mp_carentan \
#           +set probe_teleport 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28970 --probe-defuse --probe-secs 400
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28970 --probe-plant --probe-secs 380
# The server's own games_mp.log carries the lookat fires and isLookingAt's answer;
# this file is one client's side of the same run.
# probe_teleport 1 puts both probes on a courtyard spawn beside the zone; without
# it the walk starts a town away and never arrives on mp_carentan. It also puts
# the defender 20 units from the charge once it is down, inside the fuse,
# and the planter back on its spawn, off the defender's sightline.
# Phases: wait 12 s past the match-start restart; approach walks at bombzone_A's
# centre; the attacker then holds use 2 s and releases 1 s (the abort) and holds
# use through a full plant with forward sent from 2000 ms to 3500 ms; the defender
# waits the plant out, walks to the bomb and sweeps 15 view stations of 1500 ms with
# use not pressed, then aims true and holds use through the defuse.
# station origin=-225.1,2452.3,-21.9 viewangles=0.0,8.8,0.0
# ms is since the first snapshot past the join; serverTime is the server's own
# clock, and both !cmd and !trace carry it so a block reads in order.
# !cmd is every usercmd sent from the station on: st, the input bits and the
# three angle words, ANGLE2SHORT.
# !trace is one line per snapshot: the movement fields, the sweep's offset off
# the aim at the bomb in degrees, whether a 64x64 shader element (the icon) and
# a shader element with a running scaleTime (the bar) are on the wire, the
# unarchived HUD array as type:shader:w:h:fromW:fromH:scaleStart:scaleTime:x:y
# per element, and block 4 as i:state:icon:ent:team:x,y,z per non-empty slot.
!observed role=plant-attacker reached=done traced=918 cmds=1708 sweep_stations=0
